items.description:
Priva is a multi-award-winning fine-dining restaurant, champagne and cocktail lounge, cigar lounge and live-music venue in Waterkloof Heights Shopping Centre, the result of a ten-year effort to build a space built around contemporary, stylish adult dining. The kitchen offers both tasting and a la carte menus, with dishes selected and created from the finest ingredients by its team of chefs.

A temperature and humidity-controlled cigar humidor stocks a curated range for the dedicated cigar lounge, while a temperature-controlled wine cellar holds hand-selected wines that an internationally qualified sommelier and owner team can pair with the kitchen's dishes. The venue's house band, The 3 Gees Jazz Band, plays dinner music to set the mood, and a private room is available for guests wanting a more exclusive experience. Diners looking for fine dining, cigars, wine pairing or live jazz with a terrace view over Waterkloof Ridge can find all of it at this Waterkloof Heights venue.

ProGraphix Signs & Branding has provided signage and branding services in Annlin for more than five years, producing vehicle wraps, storefront signage, banners and vinyl and canvas prints with a standard 3-5 business day turnaround. PVC banners are built durable enough for both indoor and outdoor advertising, designed to grab attention whether displayed at an event or outside a shopfront.

Vehicle branding turns a business's cars, bakkies or delivery vans into moving advertising, while canvas and Correx printing covers signage needs from temporary event boards to more permanent store displays. The business uses premium materials and techniques across each of these product lines, aiming for signage that holds up to outdoor conditions rather than fading or peeling quickly. Businesses across Annlin and Pretoria needing vehicle branding, shopfront signage or printed banners can expect a turnaround of three to five business days from this Annlin-based signage company.

items.reason: ADDRESS/BUSINESS-MATCH FLAG -- current PSG adviser profiles confirm a practice trading under this name (also referred to as Magalies Noord Wealth) is real, but place it at Cirrus Eco Park, 23 Escallonia Road, Montana Park Ext 12, Pretoria 0182 (tel 012 548 0217) -- not 3 Dorethea Street, Annlin Forum as on this listing. The practice appears to have moved, or this listing's address is outdated; the Montana Park/Cirrus Eco Park address should be verified against the Annlin Forum address before a description tied to the Annlin location is published.

items.description:
Q-KON, based at Highveld Techno Park in Centurion, is a specialist technology company founded in 1988 that supplies satellite, wireless and VoIP-based communications solutions across Africa. The company delivers turn-key connectivity systems for sectors including fintech, enterprise, mining, government and tourism, enabling services such as SD-WAN, voice, broadband, ATMs and point-of-sale systems with options for primary or backup networks.

Its Twoobii product range includes Twoobii GEO, delivering global satellite communication for remote and challenging environments, and Twoobii OneWeb, built on the global OneWeb satellite constellation for broader network integration. Alongside hardware and connectivity, Q-KON offers managed services and professional engineering support, so clients are not left to run complex satellite systems without ongoing technical backing. Businesses and government bodies across Africa needing reliable connectivity in remote or under-served areas can draw on more than three decades of satellite and wireless engineering experience from this Centurion-based company.

QuantumLeap Practice Partners is a medical billing and practice management consultancy based in Irene, Centurion, working specifically with medical specialists. Its boutique-style virtual billing and accounts bureau handles day-to-day billing, while a step-by-step guidance service helps specialists who are new to private practice get set up correctly from the start.

The consultancy also runs practical practice management training courses, assists with fund and medical scheme registration including BHF registration, and helps collect outstanding and unpaid patient accounts. Beyond core billing, QuantumLeap offers social media and website services for a practice's public-facing presence, a malpractice consultation session, and help recruiting medical administrative staff. Medical specialists wanting billing, practice management training or administrative recruitment support handled by specialists in the field can work with this Centurion-based consultancy.

R&R Bistro in Villieria serves a diverse menu blending Greek, Indian, Turkish and South African dishes through tapas and main courses, with both indoor and outdoor seating and safe parking in a relaxed, family-friendly setting in the Moot area. Weekly food specials run from Tuesday through Saturday, covering dishes such as chicken schnitzel, ribs, eisbein and a traditional burger and chips.

The bistro also hosts the Making Time Market, a periodic creative family market featuring handmade crafts, DIY kits, artisan food, plants and local makers alongside the regular restaurant service. This combination of everyday dining and occasional market events gives the bistro a role in the local community beyond just serving meals. The bistro is open Tuesday to Saturday from 9am to 10pm and Sundays from 9am to 2pm, closed Mondays, serving Villieria and the Moot area for family meals or a visit to the market.

Rainbow Junction is a 140-hectare mixed-use property development in Annlin, Pretoria North, combining retail, residential, business and lifestyle space into a single precinct. At its centre is a planned 92,000 square metre regional mall, intended to anchor the development as a shopping destination for the wider Pretoria North and Annlin area.

Alongside the regional mall, the development includes the Crescent Corner retail and leisure precinct, giving visitors a mix of shopping and leisure options beyond a single large shopping centre. Residential and business components are planned within the same 140-hectare site, so homes, workplaces and retail sit close together rather than being spread across separate developments. Residents, businesses and shoppers in Annlin and Pretoria North can expect a large-scale, mixed-use precinct bringing retail, residential and business space together in one location as Rainbow Junction is developed.

Rams Consulting is a web design and hosting agency building custom WordPress and e-commerce websites, and offering domain registration, hosting, digital marketing and SEO services with remote 24/7 technical support, based in Akasia, Pretoria. For businesses just getting started online, the agency offers a simple single landing page website option alongside its full custom-build packages, plus a free .co.za domain registration with certain packages.

Hosting options range from shared web hosting through to dedicated WordPress and email hosting, letting a client choose a package that matches their site's size and traffic rather than overpaying for capacity they don't need. Social media marketing and SEO services extend the agency's work beyond just building a site into ongoing digital marketing support. The business operates Monday to Thursday from 9am to 6pm and Fridays until 3pm, closed weekends, serving Pretoria businesses needing a new website, hosting or digital marketing support.

Redblock Branding Solutions is a Pretoria signage, printing and branding company producing vehicle branding and wrapping, large-format and banner printing, and laser engraving and cutting, all in-house rather than outsourced to a third party. Being based in Derdepoort, the company works across both signage for business premises and personalised branding for individual customers.

The company's in-house 3D printing capability adds a further production option alongside its signage and engraving work, letting it produce custom shapes and prototypes without relying on an outside supplier. Redblock also supplies branded corporate gifts and clothing, giving businesses a way to combine vehicle and premises branding with staff uniforms or promotional giveaways from the same supplier. Businesses across Pretoria needing vehicle wraps, signage, laser engraving or branded corporate items can draw on Redblock's in-house production across all of these services.

RedCap Industries is a laser engraving and marking specialist with over a decade of experience, working on materials including steel, rubber stamps, wood and glass. Alongside general engraving work, the company produces school uniform marking kits that let parents label their children's clothing and belongings clearly and durably.

RedCap also supplies windscreen repair kits, extending its product range beyond engraving into a related but distinct automotive maintenance product, and produces personalised corporate gifts for businesses wanting branded items for staff or clients. Working across such a range of materials, from metal to glass, means the company can take on engraving jobs that a single-material specialist might turn down. Businesses, schools and individuals across Waterkloof Glen and Pretoria needing laser engraving, uniform marking kits or personalised corporate gifts can draw on more than ten years of experience from this Paragon Centre-based specialist.

Renaissance SA Ratings has operated as a B-BBEE verification agency since 2004, based in Lynnwood Ridge, Pretoria. The agency gained SANAS accreditation in 2010, allowing it to carry out formal BEE verifications against the DTI scorecard rather than offering informal assessments alone.

Being SANAS-accredited matters to client businesses, since a verification certificate only counts for procurement and compliance purposes if it comes from an accredited verification agency. Renaissance SA Ratings holds a Level 2 BEE certificate itself, giving it first-hand experience of the verification process it carries out for clients. Businesses across South Africa needing a SANAS-accredited B-BBEE verification can work with this Lynnwood Ridge-based agency, which has carried out this work for more than two decades.

RLWA manufactures and installs aluminium window and door systems for residential and commercial properties, using Wispeco aluminium in a range of colours and finishes, and also produces timber joinery from its Sunderland Ridge, Centurion facility. The business was founded in 2003 as a timber manufacturing company supplying and installing solid wood products, before expanding into aluminium systems in 2008 as demand grew.

A further expansion in 2012 moved the aluminium department into larger Sunderland Ridge premises, and in 2014 the company purchased three properties on the same site, increasing its manufacturing capacity by 500%. RLWA now employs more than 90 full-time staff across its timber and aluminium departments, with products built by skilled artisans who are continuously trained and tested. Homeowners, architects and commercial developers across Pretoria needing aluminium windows and doors, or timber joinery, can draw on this manufacturing growth and capacity from the same Sunderland Ridge-based company.

Roofsheeting Warehouse is a steel roofing supplier in Akasia, Pretoria, trading since 2002 and running its own in-house rollforming mills rather than buying in pre-formed sheeting from elsewhere. The business stocks galvanised, Chromadek, IBR, corrugated and polycarbonate roof sheeting, covering both standard steel roofing and the clear or tinted polycarbonate sheeting used for carports and covered walkways.

Because sheeting is rollformed on site, the business can also supply custom-cut gutters, flashings and downpipes to match a specific roof rather than only offering standard off-the-shelf sizes. This in-house manufacturing approach lets Roofsheeting Warehouse respond to orders without waiting on an external supplier for sheeting or guttering. Builders, contractors and homeowners across Akasia and greater Pretoria needing roof sheeting or matching guttering components can order directly from this manufacturer rather than a reseller.

RouterTech is a precision manufacturing and engineering business in Clubview, Centurion, with over 35 years' experience and more than 150 customers served. The company offers CAD design, precision CNC machining on modern European machines, and laser cutting across metal, wood, acrylic and other materials, including aviation-spec manufacturing.

Its specialised manufacturing service covers everything from prototype runs and 3D printing through to large-scale production, letting a client move from an initial concept to volume manufacturing with the same supplier. RouterTech's engraving and marking service covers both front and reverse engraving, used for custom designs as well as industrial part marking that needs to stay legible under wear. Businesses across Centurion and Pretoria needing CAD design, CNC machining, laser cutting or precision engraving, including aviation-spec work, can draw on more than three decades of manufacturing experience from this Clubview-based company.

S N S Engineering & Construction (Pty) Ltd is a turnkey engineering and construction company established in 1979 in Waltloo, originally as a small electrical company. Over 35 years it grew into a broader enterprise serving the motor industry and major corporations with electrical solutions, steel construction, interior renovations and HVAC installation.

The company's first major contract with Samcor SA created the foundation for its reputation in the motor industry as a competitive, innovative service provider. SNS approaches every project, regardless of size, with an emphasis on proper planning, mutual trust and communication between the company and its clients, and runs its business with attention to reducing its environmental footprint and keeping staff working in a safe environment. Motor industry clients and major corporations across South Africa needing turnkey electrical, steel construction or HVAC work can draw on more than four decades of project experience from this Pretoria-based company.

SA SawBlades supplies cutting tools including saw blades, router bits, drilling equipment, cutter heads, diamond (PCD) routers and planer knives and spares, aimed at boosting production efficiency and reducing running costs for its industrial customers. The company carries Freud-certified products, including Freud's portable pressure beam saws and its wider range, alongside an SASB private label for customers wanting an own-brand alternative.

Beyond saw blades, SA SawBlades supplies routing and drilling tooling, cutter heads and both diamond PCD routers and planer knives with spare parts, covering most of the cutting tooling a timber or panel-processing operation would need. Guidance resources on topics such as dry metal cutting, choosing the right spiral and understanding diamond tooling help customers pick the correct tool rather than guessing. The Koedoespoort-based supplier trades Monday to Thursday from 7:30am to 4:30pm and Fridays from 7:30am to 3:30pm, serving industrial customers across Pretoria needing cutting tools and related technical guidance.

Safesun Systems (Pty) Ltd is a software development company based in Pretoria, specialising in custom web applications, ERP implementation and AI-driven automation agents built with agentic AI rather than simple chatbots. The company builds modern web applications using Next.js, React and TypeScript, handling everything from the initial design system through to deployment.

Its AI-powered systems are designed to carry out real work, such as data entry, customer support and content generation, functioning as digital workers rather than conversational bots alone. On the ERP and business tools side, Safesun implements Odoo for inventory management, recurring billing and CRM, and has delivered projects including a multi-tenant SaaS platform, an e-commerce catalogue integration and an AI-powered ISO compliance system. With more than 15 years of experience and over 50 completed projects, enterprise clients across South Africa needing custom software, ERP implementation or AI-driven automation can work with this Pretoria-based development team.

SalesCollab is a sales enablement business offering marketing and lead generation, strategic business consulting, and fibre/VOIP connectivity solutions through its Marketing, Consulting and Connect divisions, and has been operating for more than five years. Its strategic advisory practice covers revenue and growth strategy, including sales process design, lead generation audits and conversion-focused funnel optimisation for businesses wanting to grow top-line sales.

On the operational side, SalesCollab helps identify the bottlenecks preventing a business from scaling, designing delivery systems, documenting processes and planning capacity so growth does not break existing operations. Its business model and finance strategy work covers pricing architecture, customer profile clarity and margin analysis, while a separate leadership alignment service helps executive teams agree on priorities and decision-making frameworks. South African businesses in Erasmusrand and beyond needing sales strategy, operational scaling advice or fibre and VOIP connectivity can draw on SalesCollab's combined consulting and connectivity offering.

SALT Beauty Bar, based in Rockfields Village, offers nail treatments including acrylic overlays, gel toes and nail art, brow waxing and tinting, rejuvenating facials and dermaplaning, teeth whitening, massage, permanent makeup, and manicures and pedicures. Facials are tailored to each client's skin type, using premium products to cleanse, exfoliate and hydrate for a more radiant complexion.

The salon's plasma treatments offer a more advanced option for clients wanting to stimulate collagen production and promote skin healing, going beyond standard facials. Waxing services cover everything from eyebrows through to legs, using gentle techniques aimed at comfort as much as results. The salon is open Monday to Saturday from 9am to 6pm and Sundays from 9am to 3pm, serving Rooihuiskraal North and the wider Centurion area for nail, skin and beauty treatments.

SAPFIN Solutions offers accounting, auditing, business consultancy, forensic and tax advisory services, alongside CIPC, SARS and labour registration assistance, for clients across sectors including wholesale and retail, hospitality, property, water management, healthcare, technology and manufacturing. The firm traces its roots back to 1986, originally operating under a different trading name before changing to Sapfin Solutions as the business grew and took on new partners.

As a 100% black-empowered professional firm and a member of both the South African Institute of Chartered Accountants and the Independent Regulatory Board for Auditors, Sapfin represents a diversified clientele across the public and private sectors. The firm built a particular niche serving the SMME sector, offering candid, practical business advice rather than only compliance work. Businesses across these industries in Laudium and wider Pretoria needing accounting, audit, tax or forensic advisory services can work with this long-established, multi-disciplinary firm.

SAVETCON is an events management company offering an end-to-end conference, congress and webinar service, organising major annual scientific and veterinary congresses and continuing professional development (CPD) events, including online learning through platforms such as Livestorm. Its calendar covers congresses for veterinary and scientific bodies such as the South African Association of Veterinary Technologists and the Poultry Group of the South African Veterinary Association.

Beyond single events, SAVETCON manages multi-year congress relationships for professional associations, handling logistics, venue booking and the practical realities of postponing or rescheduling an event when circumstances require it. The company's CPD and webinar offering lets professional bodies deliver accredited online learning to members who cannot attend an event in person. Scientific and veterinary associations across South Africa needing a congress, conference or CPD webinar managed end-to-end can work with this Monument Park-based events company.

Self Storage Estate is a brick-and-mortar storage facility on Furrow Road in Equestria, offering secure unit rentals protected by a perimeter wall, electronic fencing, cellular access control, alarms and 24-hour response, with 24-hour customer support. The facility is easily accessible from the N4 highway, making it a convenient stop for customers moving items to or from storage along that route.

Booking a unit is designed to be straightforward, with an easy application and administrative process supported by staff the business describes as efficient and friendly, rather than a lengthy paperwork-heavy sign-up. Every detail of the facility's construction has been considered for the safety of both tenants and their stored goods, reflecting a brick-and-mortar build rather than converted shipping containers. Households and businesses in Equestria and along the N4 corridor needing secure, monitored self-storage can apply for a unit at this Pretoria east facility.

SGT Solutions is an ICT network solutions integrator based in Highveld, Centurion, operating since 1993. The company works across microwave transmission, network power technologies, network field services and cyber security solutions, covering both the physical network infrastructure and its security.

Having a single integrator handle transmission, power and field services means telecoms and enterprise clients can coordinate network rollout, maintenance and power backup through one supplier rather than several separate contractors. SGT Solutions holds Level 1 B-BBEE certification, the top level under South Africa's broad-based black economic empowerment scorecard. Telecommunications operators and enterprises across South Africa needing microwave transmission, network power or cyber security support can draw on three decades of ICT integration experience from this Centurion-based company.

Shangoni Management Services, operating since 2000, is an environmental and compliance consultancy offering environmental authorisations, mine closure and rehabilitation planning, groundwater management, water and air quality monitoring and dust-analysis laboratory services, based in Die Wilgers. The company's name is a Venda word meaning 'of the earth' or 'for the earth', reflecting its focus on environmental preservation work.

Where Shangoni does not have the internal expertise for a specialist study, the company draws on a network of competent scientists to carry out the work, rather than turning a client away. In 2023, Shangoni launched Shangoni Labs, initially focused on dust analysis with plans to expand into water and other testing. The consultancy also advises on financial provision, governance and assurance services, and management system solutions for environmental compliance. Mining and industrial clients across South Africa needing environmental authorisation, mine closure planning or laboratory testing services can work with this Die Wilgers-based consultancy.

items.reason: ADDRESS/BUSINESS-MATCH FLAG -- SHTL's own website confirms the company is real, established in 2014, offering normal and abnormal load transport (low-beds, step-decks, tri-axles, super-decks), crane truck services, vehicle recovery and rigging, but states it is currently operating from the Western Cape, not Pretoria -- conflicting with this listing's address (307 Henning Street, Silverton, Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria). The Silverton/Pretoria address needs owner verification before this listing is published as a current Pretoria operation.

items.description:
SIMPLY FLEET is a Rietvalleirand, Pretoria software business offering fleet lifecycle management, covering vehicle procurement, maintenance scheduling, driver behaviour tracking, compliance reporting and end-of-life asset disposal, integrating with existing trackers, fuel cards and workshop systems. Rather than locking clients into a fixed package, the platform is built around each client's own fleet, suppliers and finance structure, recognising that a small branch fleet and a large national fleet have little in common.

Its process runs through four stages: sourcing and procurement, where suppliers compete for the client's business rather than being tied to one dealership or finance house; ongoing operation and maintenance using the client's existing tracking, banking and workshop systems; and compliance and inspection reporting structured around however the client's business actually needs to answer for it. This approach avoids the rip-and-replace disruption of switching to an entirely new system. Businesses managing vehicle fleets of any size across South Africa can use Simply Fleet to manage procurement, maintenance and compliance without replacing the tools they already use.

SNA Civil and Structural Engineers has provided civil and structural consulting engineering services since 1955, making it one of the longer-established engineering practices in Pretoria. The firm specialises in roads engineering, bridge structures and other infrastructure disciplines, working on projects that range from pavement systems to commercial and industrial structures.

SNA operates its own materials testing laboratory from its La Montagne head office, letting the practice test construction materials in-house rather than relying solely on external labs for quality assurance. The firm holds Level 1 B-BBEE accreditation, the top level under South Africa's empowerment scorecard. Government bodies, municipalities and private developers needing roads, bridge or broader civil and structural engineering services, backed by in-house materials testing, can draw on seven decades of experience from this La Montagne-based practice.

Social Company is a digital marketing and social media agency based in Bergtuin, Pretoria, offering SEO, paid advertising, social media management, web design and hosting services, with over a decade of experience serving 200+ clients. Its social media work covers building a client's online presence, creating engaging content and growing an active online community, rather than just scheduling posts.

A dedicated content creation team produces material designed to resonate with a specific target audience, and the agency builds customised digital marketing strategies around each client's particular goals rather than applying a one-size-fits-all package. Combining social media, paid advertising, SEO and web services under one agency lets clients coordinate their full digital marketing effort through a single point of contact. Businesses across Pretoria wanting social media management, content creation or a customised digital marketing strategy can draw on more than ten years of agency experience from this Bergtuin-based team.

The South African State Theatre is the largest theatre complex in Africa, with six venues and a seating capacity of around 2,700, hosting opera, ballet, musicals, drama and conferences in Pretoria Central since 1981. Beyond scheduled performances, the complex rents out space throughout the year for rehearsals, readings and other theatre events, alongside conferences, concerts, graduations, corporate events and film shoots.

Centrally located in the Pretoria CBD, the venue offers event and conference parking and is positioned as a safe, secure environment for visitors. Through its SAST TV platform, the theatre also streams some productions live and makes past shows available on demand, extending its reach to audiences who cannot attend in person. Audiences, event organisers and production companies across Pretoria can use the State Theatre for anything from a ballet performance to a corporate conference or film shoot.

Specialist Mechanical Engineers is a mechanical engineering firm based in Koedoespoort Industrial that designs and manufactures thermal and power management systems, including HVAC and power distribution solutions, serving the railway, defence, mining and automotive sectors. The company engineers products specifically for trains, trams, locomotives and passenger coaches, where reliability and durability under continuous use are critical.

For defence and security clients, the firm builds thermal and power systems for defence and security vehicles designed to withstand demanding operating conditions, while its mining and smelter products are engineered for extreme heat and heavy particulate loads. Container and shelter solutions extend the company's work into mobile or temporary structures needing climate control. Railway operators, defence contractors, mining companies and vehicle manufacturers across South Africa needing specialised thermal or power management systems can work with this Koedoespoort-based engineering firm.

ST Nubian Architects is an architecture and project management firm in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, offering master planning, urban design and concept design services for commercial and residential buildings, plus turnkey project management and engineering solutions. Its architecture service covers everything from land use and urban planning through to preliminary plans, cost estimation and the technical specifications and tender documents needed to put a project out to bid.

On project management, the firm handles construction management, building programmes, contract management and cost reporting through to final account, overseeing a project from site start to completion rather than handing off after the design phase. Its turnkey solutions extend into product evaluations, feasibility studies, industrial layout design, and electrical, mechanical and data systems engineering, covering technical disciplines beyond architecture alone. Developers and property owners in Die Wilgers and across Pretoria needing master planning, architectural design or full turnkey project delivery can work with this multidisciplinary firm.

Steval Engineering (Pty) Ltd is a structural steel and mechanical engineering contractor, founded in 1997, specialising in the fabrication and erection of piping and plating, pressure vessels, tank farms and civil work for engineering, procurement and construction projects. The company built its reputation primarily on the erection and fabrication of structural steel, with an early focus on tanks, vessels and storage solutions for clients in the steel and industrial sector.

Steval has positioned itself around a deliberate business strategy rather than simply chasing available orders, a focus the company credits with helping it keep working through difficult periods for South Africa's steel industry. This combination of quality service, product innovation and diversification has let the company take on EPC project work that smaller, less strategically focused contractors might not sustain through an industry downturn. EPC contractors and industrial clients needing structural steel fabrication, pressure vessels or tank farm construction can work with this Rooiwal-based engineering contractor.

Stor-Age Self Storage Centurion, Midstream offers personal and business self-storage in over 40 unit sizes along with vehicle storage, van rental, parcel collection and a packaging shop, with rentals from a minimum of one month. The Louwlardia branch is part of the wider Stor-Age network, giving customers a consistent storage experience across multiple South African locations.

Business storage is positioned as a flexible alternative to leasing additional warehouse or office space, letting a growing business store stock or equipment without committing to a longer-term lease. The van rental service helps customers move belongings into and out of their unit without arranging separate transport, and the parcel collection service lets customers have deliveries received at the facility when they are not available at home. The branch is accessible Monday to Friday from 7am to 6pm and weekends from 8am to 5pm, serving Midstream and the wider Centurion area for personal or business self-storage needs.

STR Engineering Services supplies and maintains industrial gearboxes and power transmission equipment for the mining and industrial sectors in Centurion, partnering with manufacturers including SEW, Siemens, Rossi, Bonfiglioli and Flender for support, service and repairs. Working with several major gearbox and drive manufacturers rather than a single brand means the company can support and repair equipment regardless of which manufacturer a client's existing machinery came from.

The business positions its depth of expertise and focus on developing technologies as what lets it compete across a wide range of industries, rather than specialising narrowly in one type of machinery. Teamwork between its technical staff is treated as the company's main resource for solving the varied problems that gearbox and power transmission faults can present on an industrial site. Mining and industrial clients across Centurion and the wider region needing gearbox or power transmission equipment supplied, serviced or repaired can work with this multi-brand specialist.

Sunumi PTY LTD manufactures custom enclosures for solar and electrical infrastructure in Waltloo, Pretoria, including battery cabinets, inverter housings, switchgear enclosures, and containerised solutions, trading since 2023 under the Real Solid Consulting group. Although Sunumi itself was established as a dedicated enclosure manufacturing brand in 2023, it draws on 26 years of industry experience brought in through the group's existing leadership and technical foundation.

Enclosures are built for both indoor and outdoor applications, with weather-resistant and tamper-resistant designs intended to withstand harsh operating environments, and fire-rated enclosure options are available for installations where that is a requirement. Products have been installed to support commercial and industrial projects across the African continent, not only in South Africa. Installers, contractors and industrial clients across Africa needing custom-built, durable enclosures for solar or electrical infrastructure can work with this Waltloo-based manufacturer.

SureSystems is a Meyerspark-based payment technology company offering SUREdebit, a Debicheck and debit order collection platform, along with wireless POS terminals and cashless payout solutions; it is a PASA-registered system operator and PCI DSS compliant. SUREdebit is mobile-friendly, letting merchants load and manage Debicheck transactions from a tablet, mobile phone, laptop or point-of-sale terminal rather than only from a desktop system.

The platform supports several Debicheck transaction types, including real-time and delayed authentication methods where customers confirm a transaction by cellphone, cellphone banking, USSD or ATM, and a real-time option using a POS terminal with card and PIN that needs no cellphone at all. For collections outside the Debicheck system, SureSystems also offers an EFT debit order service for merchants working from a signed debit order mandate. Merchants needing a compliant debit order or Debicheck collection platform, wireless POS terminals or cashless payouts can work with this PASA-registered, PCI DSS-compliant provider.

Tan Pixels Creative Studio is a software and web design studio in Eloffsdal offering website design, logo design, branding and poster design, along with digital marketing services for clients across legal, wellness and other industries. Combining web design with branding and poster work under one studio lets a client keep their visual identity consistent across a website, printed materials and online marketing.

Working across industries such as legal and wellness means the studio adapts its design approach to the tone each sector needs, rather than applying a single visual style to every client. Digital marketing services extend the studio's work beyond a one-off website or logo build into ongoing promotion once a brand's visual identity is in place. Businesses and professionals across Pretoria needing a new website, logo, brand identity or printed marketing materials can work with this Eloffsdal-based creative studio.

Teddy Trailers, also trading as Mobile Kitchen Trailers SA, manufactures custom mobile kitchen trailers, mobile VIP toilet units and mobile freezer units for food businesses, events and construction sites, built to order in Annlin, Pretoria. The range extends to custom vending units, cold rooms and luggage trailers, giving the business a wider product line than kitchen trailers alone.

Mobile VIP toilet units are designed for events, construction sites and VIP functions needing clean, durable sanitation beyond standard portable toilets, built for comfort and dependable performance in varied conditions. Every trailer is custom-built to match a client's exact requirements rather than sold as a fixed standard model, with delivery available nationwide once a build is complete. Food businesses, event organisers and construction companies across South Africa needing a custom mobile kitchen, VIP toilet unit or freezer trailer can order directly from this Annlin-based manufacturer.

Thabi Consulting is a 100% black-owned audit and advisory firm in Heuweloord offering internal and statutory audit support, bookkeeping, fraud-prevention training and IT audit services, with staff holding CA(SA), CFE, CIA and CISA certifications. The firm is formally registered with SAICA, the Institute of Internal Auditors, the Association of Certified Fraud Examiners and ISACA, giving it accreditation across financial, internal and IT audit disciplines.

Beyond completing an audit, Thabi works with management to draft action plans addressing any internal control weaknesses identified, aiming to alleviate the technical burden on a client's own staff during the process. This close engagement is also designed to transfer audit and compliance skills to the client's management and employees, rather than leaving them dependent on an external auditor each year. Organisations across the public and private sectors needing statutory, internal or IT audit services, combined with practical skills transfer, can work with this Heuweloord-based firm.

Thaliwe's is a Level 1 BBBEE, 100% black woman-owned skills-development company in Theresapark, registered with the CIPC in January 2009, providing accredited training, entrepreneurship assistance, internships and learnerships across the services, agriculture and mining sectors. The company was founded on the back of more than twenty years of experience in the mining and minerals industry, combining qualified metallurgy expertise with human resource development specialisation.

This background shapes the company's accredited training interventions, which are designed to be internationally recognised and quality assured, delivered by mentors, coaches and subject matter experts rather than generic course material. Thaliwe's was established in response to South Africa's general skills shortage, high unemployment and the lack of support available to small businesses, with a particular focus on sharing practical, hands-on knowledge. Businesses and individuals in the services, agriculture and mining sectors needing accredited training, learnerships or entrepreneurship support can work with this Theresapark-based, black woman-owned skills-development company.

The Giving Green Store is a family-run online plant and plant-gift retailer established in 2022, selling houseplants nationwide with careful packaging and personal service, and offering collection visits by appointment from its Wingate Park base. The range runs from easy-care favourites to colourful statement plants such as peace lilies and rubber plants, alongside bundled options like a build-your-own green trio for customers wanting several plants at once.

Plants are also positioned as gifts for birthdays, housewarmings and other occasions, since a living plant keeps growing long after the gift wrapping is gone, unlike many standard gift items. As a small, local plant shop rather than a large retailer, the business takes pride in choosing healthy plants and packaging them carefully for the journey from its own greenhouse to a customer's home anywhere in South Africa. Plant lovers and gift buyers nationwide can order houseplants or plant gifts online from this Wingate Park-based family business, with local collection available by appointment.

The Hills Game Reserve Estate is an upmarket residential lifestyle estate in Mooikloof, Pretoria East, spanning 1,200 acres with a private game reserve stocked with antelope and zebra, and this listing covers its Atterbury Road gatehouse and access point. The estate consists of 996 stands ranging from 500m² to 3,900m², with residents able to choose a standard, greenbelt or larger stand, including some located within the game reserve itself for more expansive views.

Lifestyle facilities on the estate include the Reddford House private school, walking, mountain biking and game trails, and a clubhouse with a double-storey gym offering weekly classes and an on-site restaurant. Convenient access is available from both Garsfontein Road and this Atterbury Road gatehouse, keeping the estate within a short drive of upmarket shopping centres in the area. Residents and prospective buyers entering through the Atterbury Gate House can reach the estate's stands, game reserve and lifestyle facilities from this access point.

The Pallet Farmstall is a family-friendly, dog-friendly farm stall in Rietvalleirand offering daily fresh bread, frozen meals, fresh fruit and vegetables, wood-fired pizza and coffee. The farm stall combines a produce and ready-meal shop with a casual eatery, so visitors can either stock up on groceries or sit down for pizza and coffee on the same visit.

For families, the farm stall adds pony rides, go-karts and a jungle gym, giving children something to do while adults shop or relax over coffee. Dogs are welcome on the property, which is less common at a typical grocery or farm shop and suits visitors who would otherwise need to leave a pet at home. The farm stall is open daily, from 7am on weekdays extending to 7pm on Fridays, with shorter hours on Saturdays and Sundays, serving Rietvalleirand families looking for fresh produce, casual food and children's activities in one stop.

The Pro Shop Lynnwood Superstore is a specialist golf retailer at Lynnwood Bridge Shopping Centre, stocking golf equipment, apparel and accessories for players of all skill levels, with staff on hand to offer buying advice. The store is part of The Pro Shop, South Africa's largest golf equipment retailer, with sister stores in Cape Town, Johannesburg and Durban alongside this Pretoria branch.

Shoppers can expect a Price Match Guarantee and a 30-day satisfaction promise, backed by what the retailer positions as the widest product range in the country and competitive trade-in prices for golfers wanting to upgrade existing clubs. The store offers Xact Fit master club fitting, helping golfers find clubs matched to their own swing rather than buying off the shelf. Golfers across Pretoria, from beginners to more experienced players, can get equipment, apparel, club fitting and trade-in advice at this Lynnwood Bridge store, open Monday to Saturday from 9am to 5pm and Sundays from 9am to 2pm.

The Solar Box designs and installs tailored solar power systems for homes and businesses in Roodeplaat, offering site assessments, cost analysis and full installation to help clients get off the grid and cut energy costs. The process starts with a comprehensive needs analysis, followed by an on-site inspection where a professional assesses requirements and recommends a scalable solution to match the client's budget.

A detailed solar energy cost analysis then weighs up different technical solutions and purchasing or implementation options, removing uncertainty over future electricity tariffs before a client commits. Once a quote is accepted, installation is booked and carried out based on the property's specific energy needs and structural requirements. The business is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm, closed Sundays, serving homeowners and businesses across Roodeplaat and the surrounding area wanting a tailored, professionally assessed solar installation.

threeframes is a boutique consulting firm based in Eco Park, Centurion, working with government and corporate clients through an analyse-design-implement methodology. The firm advises on modernisation and strategy projects, helping clients move from a current state to a planned future state in a structured, phased way rather than an ad hoc approach.

Its service range covers defence consulting, programme and project management, enterprise architecture, and business process re-engineering, giving it a spread across both strategic advisory work and the more technical disciplines needed to implement change. Working with both government and corporate clients means the firm applies similar methodology across the public and private sectors rather than treating them separately. Government departments and corporations needing strategic modernisation, enterprise architecture or business process re-engineering support can engage this Centurion-based boutique consultancy.

Tiger Food Brands Ltd operates a manufacturing facility in Waltloo as part of Tiger Brands, a major South African food and beverage company known for brands such as Oros, focused on providing affordable, quality nutrition. The group's stated purpose is to cultivate and nourish lives every day, built around a belief that everyone should have access to good food and quality household essentials.

Tiger Brands structures its sustainability approach around three pillars: health and nutrition, aimed at helping consumers improve their wellbeing through affordable good nutrition; enhanced livelihoods, intended to improve conditions for the many people connected to its supply chain; and caring for the environment. The Waltloo facility forms part of the manufacturing base supporting this national food and beverage business. Retailers and consumers across South Africa encounter Tiger Brands products manufactured in part through facilities such as this Waltloo site in Pretoria.

TM Global Forwarding (Pty) Ltd is a Clubview-based freight and logistics company offering air, sea and road freight, cargo courier, customs clearing and household removal services, drawing on more than 20 years of industry relationships. The company takes a personal rather than technical approach to shipping, assigning a single team member to see a client's cargo through from origin to destination instead of passing it between departments.

Its packing service covers pallets and crates, temperature-sensitive packing, professional packing for household moves, and specialised rigging or crane hire for awkward or heavy items. On customs clearing, TM Global Forwarding handles both import and export clearing in South Africa and in most other countries, assists with SADC certificates, and guides clients through SARS registration for import and export licences even though it is not itself a licensing service. Businesses and individuals needing freight, customs clearing or household removals, handled by a dedicated point of contact, can work with this Clubview-based forwarder.

Top Decks, Gauteng is a carpentry business in Wapadrand, Pretoria, building and installing custom timber decks, patios, pergolas, pool decks and built-in braais, and is a preferred installer for Envirodeck and Rhino Wood composite decking. The company's range extends beyond decking into wooden flooring, balustrading and handrails, along with jacuzzi and splash pool sales and installation for clients building a fuller outdoor entertainment area.

Tiling, cladding and canvas awning installation round out the business's outdoor and entertainment-area offering, letting a client cover decking, flooring, pool features and shade in one project rather than coordinating several separate contractors. Operating in both Pretoria and Cape Town gives the company experience building timber structures suited to South Africa's varied climate, where good timber decking can be enjoyed year-round. Homeowners across Wapadrand and wider Pretoria wanting a timber deck, patio, pergola or built-in braai, or a fuller outdoor entertainment upgrade, can work with this Envirodeck and Rhino Wood-approved installer.

Top Roof Waterproofing is a roofing and waterproofing specialist in Villieria, Pretoria, handling tiled and iron-roof waterproofing, torch-on flat roofs, roof painting, gutters, ceilings and insulation, backed by a 5-year guarantee on its waterproofing work. Torch-on waterproofing is applied to flat roofs to handle large volumes of water, protecting concrete slabs from water and sun damage for years at a time.

Beyond waterproofing itself, the company installs and repairs barge and fascia boards, which protect a roof's timber edges from the elements while giving a clean finish, and offers seamless gutter installation alongside ongoing gutter maintenance and repairs. Ceiling installations and Isotherm insulation services extend the business into the inside of the roof space, not just its waterproofing. The business is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8am to 2pm, closed Sundays, serving Villieria and the wider Pretoria area for roofing, waterproofing and related repair work.
